name: interview-insights
description: Convenience scripts across api/web/workers. Each service keeps its own package-lock.json and is built/deployed independently (see each Dockerfile) — this is not an npm workspaces root.

scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix api && npm run lint --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix api && npm test --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix workers
